title: Capacity
description: How many man-days a team has in a sprint. Everyone can read it; only the team's manager and administrators edit it.

team.label: Team
team.none: There is no team yet. An administrator adds teams on the Teams page.

sprint.label: Sprint
sprint.none: This team has no sprints yet. They appear after the next sync.

pick: Pick a team and a sprint to see its capacity calendar.

default.title: Team default capacity
default.intro: One figure in man-days for every sprint of this team that has no calendar. Precedence: the sprint's calendar, then this figure, then the members times the working days.
default.invalid: Enter a figure from 0 to 999999.99, or leave it blank for none.
default.readOnly: Only the team's manager or an administrator can edit the team's capacity.

calendar.title: Sprint calendar
calendar.teamCoefficientHint: Multiplies the whole team's capacity (0 to 2).
calendar.defaults: Showing computed defaults. Save to store this calendar.
calendar.derivedNone: Capacity in reports: none for this sprint
calendar.noWindow: This sprint has no start date or lasts over 60 days, so it has no calendar.
calendar.readOnly: Only the team's manager or an administrator can edit the team's capacity.
calendar.noPeople: No team member overlaps this sprint, so there is nobody to plan.
calendar.changedElsewhere: This calendar changed elsewhere — Reset to load the latest. Saving now overwrites it.
calendar.totalHint: Saving it makes reports use it.

grid.tableAria: Availability of each person on each day of the sprint
grid.legendOff: Not counted (a day or a person turned off)

error.forbidden: You can no longer edit this team's capacity.
error.notFound: This team or sprint no longer exists.
error.conflict: This sprint has no start date, so it has no calendar.
error.invalidCalendar: The calendar no longer fits the sprint (its days or people changed). Press Reset to load the current one, then redo your edits.
error.invalidDefault: The default capacity was rejected. Enter a figure from 0 to 999999.99.
